title: 统计星号
summary: 字符串由成对竖线划分若干区域，统计不在任意竖线对内部的星号数量。
insight: 扫描时每遇竖线切换 inside 状态，只在 inside 为假时累计星号。
pitfalls: 多个分隔区域需反复切换状态

solutions.title: 竖线状态切换
solutions.idea: 一个布尔状态表示当前是否位于竖线对中。

code.java: class Solution { public int countAsterisks(String s){boolean inside=false;int answer=0;for(char ch:s.toCharArray())if(ch=='|')inside=!inside;else if(ch=='*'&&!inside)answer++;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countAsterisks(s:String):Int{var inside=false;var answer=0;for(ch in s)if(ch=='|')inside=!inside else if(ch=='*'&&!inside)answer++;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countAsterisks(string s){bool inside=false;int answer=0;for(char ch:s)if(ch=='|')inside=!inside;else if(ch=='*'&&!inside)++answer;return answer;} };
